motion.interpolation: Default clips: select existing PNGs at 60 fps; preserve the original 60 fps firefly tracks exactly. Yawn exception: corrected preparation poses and fresh RIFE interpolation; see reference/yawn-repair/runtime.json.

sleepBreathing.interpolation: RIFE 4.6 temporal TTA; RGBA dual matte
sleepBreathing.endpointCorrection: FFmpeg float premultiplied-alpha smoothstep composition for phases 1..15; original rest is exact and phases 16 onward remain RIFE output.

legacyAuthoring.interpolation: RIFE 4.6 temporal TTA; complete RGBA dual-matte poses
legacyAuthoring.registration: Grounded front-paw registration; complete head, ears, decoration and shoulders remain free to move. No nose registration or facial cutout.
legacyAuthoring.endpointCorrection: FFmpeg floating-point premultiplied-alpha smoothstep only at three inferred phases beside each exact key

rise.holdDuration: Configured by the behavior controller; hold remains a static loop.

clickReactions.selection: equal probability among available single-click reactions

motion.authoringInterpolation: RIFE 4.6 temporal TTA; RGBA dual matte
motion.idleSelection: Weighted idle actions: blink 2, yawn 1, rise/hold/settle 1, firefly 1. The behavior controller owns compound rise playback.

sampling.method: Select the original frame at rounded 60 Hz start times; clamp the final slot to the original duration and retain the final pose. Static clips stay single-slot. Firefly character and decoration slots are copied unchanged.

sourceSampling.method: Original-time frame selection at rounded 120 Hz boundaries; original first/last pose retained; repeated slots kept; static clips unchanged.

firefly.method: Approved v3 analytic animation exported losslessly at its original 60 fps; shared cat/overlay time slots.
No resampling; both approved 600-slot tracks are copied byte-for-byte as JSON values.

yawn.method: Rebuild only yawn from corrected preparation composites; retain every original 60 fps phase and duration.
